prompt: Ultra-realistic luxury street-style editorial portrait of an elegant older woman with timeless beauty, photographed in soft natural daylight against a clean, minimalist urban background. She gazes gracefully to the side with a warm, confident smile, radiating sophistication, wisdom, and effortless style. She has beautifully styled silver-gray hair swept into a sleek, low chignon with smooth volume and refined texture. Her skin shows natural mature beauty with delicate expression lines, soft wrinkles, and a luminous healthy complexion. She wears bold matte red lipstick, subtle natural makeup, and oversized round black designer sunglasses with glossy frames, adding a chic high-fashion aesthetic. Her outfit consists of a striking royal-blue pleated sleeveless designer dress featuring an elegant asymmetrical folded collar with sculptural architectural lines. She accessorizes with luxurious statement drop earrings in antique silver and black gemstone detailing, along with a thin metallic crossbody chain strap that subtly drapes across her shoulder. Soft diffused daylight creates flattering illumination with gentle highlights on her skin and hair while maintaining realistic textures. The background is artistically blurred with a shallow depth of field, emphasizing her refined profile and sophisticated styling. The overall mood conveys confidence, elegance, and timeless fashion. Style: Ultra-photorealistic luxury fashion photography, street-style editorial portrait, Vogue editorial aesthetic, minimalist composition, authentic mature beauty, cinematic soft lighting, premium designer styling, realistic skin texture, natural silver hair detail, shallow depth of field, 85mm portrait lens, DSLR quality, HDR, magazine-quality retouching, ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, luxury lifestyle campaign, timeless elegance, award-winning editorial photography.

promptZh:
超写实奢华街拍时尚大片，展现了一位拥有永恒之美的优雅成熟女性，在干净、极简的城市背景下，于柔和的自然光中拍摄。她优雅地侧目凝视，带着温暖而自信的微笑，散发出成熟、智慧与从容的时尚气息。
她有着精心打理的 梳成利落低发髻的银灰色秀发，发丝蓬松顺滑，质感考究。她的皮肤展现出自然的成熟之美，带有细腻的表情纹、柔和的皱纹以及健康透亮的光泽。她涂抹着 大胆的哑光红唇，妆容自然清透，佩戴着超大圆形黑色设计师太阳镜，镜框光泽感十足，增添了时髦的高级感。
她的造型是一件引人注目的 宝蓝色 无袖百褶设计师连衣裙，领口设计优雅，采用不对称折叠与雕塑般的建筑线条。她佩戴着奢华的复古银质黑宝石吊坠耳环，肩上斜挎着一条细金属链条，自然垂落，更显精致。
柔和的漫射光营造出迷人的照明效果，在她的皮肤和发丝上留下柔和的高光，同时保留了真实的纹理。背景经过艺术化虚化处理，景深较浅，突显了她精致的侧颜与高级的造型。整体氛围传达出自信、优雅与永恒的时尚感。
风格：超写实奢华时尚摄影，街拍时尚大片，Vogue 杂志风格，极简构图，真实的成熟之美，电影级柔光，高端设计师造型，真实的皮肤纹理，自然的银发细节，浅景深，85mm 人像镜头，单反相机画质，HDR，杂志级修图，超高清细节，8K 分辨率，奢华生活方式广告大片，永恒的优雅，获奖级时尚摄影。
